integrity: Every rank count follows from a complete symbolic homomorphism classification. Small-case exhaustive computations check but do not replace the all-size proof.
scientific_limitations: Classification applies only to flat interval semirings of bounded height-two diamond posets; no arbitrary-poset, arbitrary graph-semiring, or general semigroup endomorphism assertion. Historical priority beyond inspected literature remains uncertain.
title: Endomorphism rank gaps and retraction counts for diamond interval semirings
